description:
EMJM Imaging is an Erasmus Mundus master dedicated to imaging science — from medical imaging to photonics and computational imaging — delivered by a French-led consortium. The 2027-2029 application dates had not been posted at the time of checking; the previous round closed in early January 2026, so a similar timeline is likely.

Programme Highlights

  • Imaging-focused curriculum spanning biomedical, photonics and computational tracks
  • Previous scholarship round closed in early January; 2027-2029 dates pending
  • Mobility across European research universities and imaging labs
  • Graduates enter medtech, imaging research and doctoral programmes

Who Should Apply

Physics, engineering, computer science and biomedical graduates with signal/image processing interest are the natural cohort.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the EMJM Imaging website for the official 2027-2029 call and prepare documents ahead of the January-style window. Key deadline information: 2027-2029 round dates to be announced (the previous round closed in early January 2026) — check the official site.
